fact_text: Data Vault runs a software house and data-centre business, and its CEO says it is the only AI-enabled data centre in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: In 2020 the company decided to start a data-centre business, first testing it on GPUs it already supplied to clients.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The company operates data centres in Karachi, including one on Sharah-e-Faisal, and a Faisalabad site the CEO describes as government-approved.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The company says it has three data-centre locations in the USA, one of them in Dallas, plus locations in the Middle East.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The company's clients include banks, health-care providers, a telecom operator and government bodies, and its facilities host CDN equipment for Facebook and Google.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The company says it has about 250 employees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The CEO's earlier group of companies, started in 2009, was a software house offering software, web design, web development and mobile app services.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The CEO's group later registered an LLC in Dubai and a company in Riyadh, and began serving clients in the USA and Europe as a business-process outsourcing and back-office provider.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The CEO said she began as a marketing manager in digital marketing and SEO at an earlier company before starting her own firm as sole proprietor with two people.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan has a data residency policy and a cloud-first policy, under which sensitive data may not be sent abroad or hosted outside the country.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The CEO argued that bank and health-care data hosted abroad, or uploaded to foreign AI chatbots, exposes sensitive national information to foreign access and misuse.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The CEO's thesis is that data residency rules create domestic demand for local data-centre capacity, since banks and health-care firms were hosting data abroad as of 2025-10-24.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The CEO said AI voice-bot call centres that host their data abroad and pay foreign cloud providers send that spending out of Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The company announced Jahanat AI, a large language model built for Urdu speakers with local cultural knowledge, with a public launch planned for early November 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The CEO said Jahanat AI is meant for Urdu speakers who do not use English, answering in Urdu and giving locally sold medicine advice.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The company's next step is regional languages, aimed at interior Punjab, where the CEO said many people know neither English nor Urdu and so stay outside the mainstream economy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The CEO said AI makes it realistic for Pakistan to aim for a central role in the global AI platform market, which was much harder before AI.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The CEO quoted the Prime Minister as calling the AI industry a trillion-dollar industry.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: Job postings seen by the CEO as of 2025-10-24 asked for roles such as AI project manager, AI product manager and GPU cloud architect.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)

fact_text: The CEO argued that humanoid robots and AI bots could eventually take over trades such as plumbing and carpentry, which she said would make such services easier to buy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mahwish Salman's Extraordinary Journey from Babysitter to Data Vault CEO | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-24)
